data.findings: Prior audit corrective actions not verified closed; 3 procedures referencing superseded equipment still in circulation; Only 1 near-miss reported in 12 months for crew of 24
data.action: Flag state notified. Re-inspection required within 3 months.

data.findings: Sleeping room below MLC Reg. 3.1 minimum area; Galley refrigeration defective; Crew unaware of complaint procedure
data.action: Deficiencies to be rectified before next Australian port call.

data.findings: 4 CO2 bottles with broken seals in engine room; Fire panel zone faults acknowledged and silenced without rectification; 3 EEBDs with expired service dates
data.action: Vessel detained 48 hours. Deficiencies independently verified before release.

data.findings: ECDIS — no back-up arrangement; paper charts not carried; No pre-departure passage plan for coastal leg; AIS static data incorrect
data.action: Improvement notice issued. Corrections required before departure.

data.findings: No. 3 and No. 5 hatch cover seals leaking; No. 4 hold bilge pump inoperable; BWTS not used on last ballast voyage; Record Book incomplete
data.action: Vessel detained. Structural repairs completed at anchorage before release.
